description: This file implements a helper class for managing local notifications in a Flutter application. It handles initialization of notification settings for Android and iOS, displays notifications with action buttons for saving news articles, routes notification interactions into app navigation and state management, and manages platform-specific notification channels and permissions.

classes.name: LocalNotifications
classes.description: A helper class to manage local notifications for the app, including initialization, displaying notifications, and handling responses/actions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes local notifications, sets up platform-specific settings, request permissions, and registers response handlers.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Displays a 'Saved' notification with action buttons for opening saved articles or undoing the save.

methods.name: _articleFromPayload
methods.description: Decodes JSON payload to reconstruct a NewsArticle object.

methods.name: _handleAction
methods.description: Handles notification action responses, such as navigation or undoing a save.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback triggered when a notification response is received; delegates to _handleAction.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveBackgroundNotificationResponse
methods.description: Background callback for notification responses; delegates to _handleAction.
